dataset.title: Loophole-free Bell test using electron spins in diamond: second experiment and additional analysis

methods_review.status: INDEPENDENT RAW-DATA REANALYSIS IMPLEMENTED; checksum and fixed regression criteria pass
differences_from_2015: Old and replacement APD records are separate immutable files and retain independent SHA-256 digests.
The replacement APD uses a 700 ps adjusted channel-0 event-ready start (5425300 ps versus 5426000 ps); channel 1 starts at 5425100 ps.

Author event-ready filter uses a 50000 ps first window, 250000 ps separation, 50000 ps psi-minus second window, and 4000 ps (channel 0) / 2500 ps (channel 1) psi-plus second windows to reduce after-pulsing.
The 2016 run includes both psi-minus and psi-plus heralded states; state-specific scores are retained before weighting.
The 2016 paper adds classical random bits to quantum RNG setting choices and reports additional 70 ns before measurement; no timing loophole comparison is inferred from the raw-score reproduction.

analysis.filters: Author example independently ported from Python 2.7: both event-ready clicks inside APD-specific windows; state-specific second window; invalid markers zero or >250; no after-excitation clicks; outcomes +1 for 10620 < readout_time_ns <= 14320, else -1.
analysis.statistics: Per-setting E=mean(A*B), binomial marginal SE sqrt((1-E^2)/n); state-specific CHSH sign convention; state CHSH weighted by accepted trial count and SE propagated in quadrature; complete score win count and exact binomial upper tail with q=0.75+3*(tau+tau^2), tau=1.08e-5.
analysis.predeclared_criteria: Verify both SHA-256 source hashes, exactly 300 accepted trials, S within +/-0.0055 of 2.35 and SE within +/-0.0055 of 0.18. No parameters fitted.
analysis.status: VALIDATED for reproduction of the published rounded data analysis; physical apparatus validation remains NOT IMPLEMENTED.

methods_review.analysis_policy: 2015 and 2016 filters and settings remain separate. Combined summary uses trial-count weighted CHSH and sums the author-score wins; it does not pool state or apparatus metadata.
